title: Unreal Engine Reverse Engineering and UE games rewrite
author: Ellrise
selftext:
I'm pretty much a beginner at most things but I've seen the recent news with people rewriting entire softwares or games in Rust.   
I had an idea but I'm pretty sure it needs a team of competent people and quite some time, it's not something you can vibe code in a few days.

"Modern Unreal Engine titles rely on a massive, proprietary structural framework (such as `UObject` arrays, garbage collection, and heavy reflection systems). A raw binary dump stripped of names is a labyrinth of anonymous machine code that an AI cannot cleanly reconstruct into a fully functional standalone engine. \[[1](https://www.patreon.com/guidedhacking/posts/reverse-unreal-5-149359548), [2](https://www.popularai.org/p/ai-reverse-engineering-software-binaries)\]"

With enough work wouldn't it be possible to build a sort of guide so the AI knows and understand how to work from UE games binaries ? 

Ways to build a UE game project from the game binaries ? 

I think this would open up so much possibilities.

In my own case, there's a game I'd like to take inspiration from. It would be easier for me to work and customize what I want instead of building it from scratch. If not building an entire game, it could at least help me experiment and build a game designer portfolio.  
I'm aware of copyright issues and some people might use such a project in a wrong way. That's not my intention.

If you're talented and interested maybe comment and you guys gather to build this ?

comments.author: taisui
comments.body: No and why? unrela engine is practically free

comments.author: Itadorijin
comments.body: Unreal engine code is source available you don't need to reverse engineer it.

replies.author: Ellrise
replies.body: Yeah you have the engine but not the games that are made with the engine

comments.author: TimothyCarmack
comments.body: New GPT and Claude AI models can already build and modify Unreal Engine games, you don't need a special skill or MCP server. It can already do it.

replies.author: Ellrise
replies.body: Do you have any examples ? I've been searching but couldn't find any

replies.author: TimothyCarmack
replies.body: just google "unreal engine mod made with AI" and you'll find hundreds of resources. Also if you don't know how it works, you just pay for Codex, enable 1 of the 2 most expensive models, set it to Planning mode, and then you say "do everything required to build a modern deployable mod for this game that does xxxx, don't prompt me on what to do, figure it all out yourself, download and install whatever you need and don't stop until you've proven it's ready to distribute" and then let is spend 200$ doing it over the course of 4-16 hours. let the modern expensive AI figure it all out, don't even bother telling it how to do it, you only have to do that with cheap or older models.

comments.author: jusore
comments.body:
El paradigma ha cambiado y todo software es potencialmente de código abierto ahora.  
  
Dada la complejidad de los grandes motores, se tardará más, pero sera beneficioso abrirlos y que se beneficie la comunidad. Sin ir más lejos, Bevy, escrito en rust (o algún fork suyo), podría dar un gran salto de capacidad.
